title: Seeking Sources for Utility Energy Services Contract (UESC) at Fort Jackson, North Carolina
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.US ARMY CORPS OF ENGINEERS.SCO ALEXANDRIA.SUPPORT CENTER HUNTSVILLE.W2V6 USA ENG SPT CTR HUNTSVIL
detail_text: This is a Sources Sought notice issued by the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Huntsville Center, for market research purposes. We are seeking qualified and capable firms to provide a Utility Energy Services Contract (UESC) for Fort Jackson, North Carolina. This is not a Request for Proposal (RFP), and the government will not reimburse respondents for any costs associated with this notice.
